subject: CloudNova questionnaire path & evidence clarification
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodeval.com>
To: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@cloudnova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodeval.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodeval.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudNova questionnaire path & evidence clarification

Hi Asha —

Thanks for taking the time on the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary from our side:
- CloudNova interest: integrate Redwood for inference on user-facing product recommendations; initial scope ~50M tokens/month.
- Primary compliance asks called out on the call: SOC 2 status & recent report, GDPR data processing controls, and a vendor questionnaire for security due in procurement.

Questions / asks from Redwood (so we can prefill efficiently):
1) For procurement: would you prefer a completed SIG Lite (OpenSSF/SIG) prefill, CAIQ, or your custom questionnaire? 
2) Is there a defined deadline for the questionnaire/evidence (procurement mentioned end of next week verbally)?
3) Which environment will store evaluation data (CloudNova-managed S3 vs. Redwood-hosted) — this affects evidence we map.

Next steps we propose:
- We can send a SIG Prefill + evidence map by EOD today to speed procurement.
- If you need a CAIQ instead, let us know and we’ll switch templates.
- Assign a point-of-contact for evidence followups (Ben can lead on evidence collection).

Attachments: we’ll attach a SIG prefill template and an initial evidence map after I confirm preferred form.

Thanks — looking forward to your preference so we can kick this off.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[kimberly_park@redwoodeval.com]

[Attachment stub: redwood_SIG_prefill_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@cloudnova.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodeval.com>
Cc: CloudNova Procurement <procure@cloudnova.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudNova questionnaire path & evidence clarification

On Fri, Sep 25, 2027 at 09:12 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodeval.com> wrote:
> Hi Asha —
> 
> Thanks for taking the time on the call this morning...

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the clear summary. Procurement did say they preferred a SIG Lite prefill if it’s quick — they flagged a short internal deadline of 2027-10-04 for vendor due diligence.

Answers inline:
1) SIG Lite prefill preferred (but if SIG Lite exposes gaps we may ask for a few CAIQ items).
2) Target deadline: 2027-10-04 (procurement).
3) Evaluation artifacts: CloudNova will host any test data in their evaluation S3 (dev), but we will need access to redacted logs/console screenshots from Redwood for some controls.

Point of contact: I’ll be the primary security contact (Asha Reddy). Procurement contact is procurement@cloudnova.com. Please send the SIG prefill and evidence map; we’ll triage and route to procurement for their checklist.

Thanks,
Asha
Security Analyst, CloudNova
asha.reddy@cloudnova.com

[No attachments]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodeval.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodeval.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodeval.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2027 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudNova questionnaire path & evidence clarification (internal)

Kim — quick internal note while you prepare the prefill:
- I’ll start the evidence runbook: SOC 2 cert (2026 report), SOC 2 scope document, encryption-at-rest KMS screenshots, K8s cluster config (RBAC snippets), and our data retention policy.
- Priyom: can you validate which screenshots we can redact safely (console user ids) and whether we have an audit log extract for the last 90 days? Procurement often asks for that.
- If CloudNova insists on CAIQ later, we should be ready with the CAIQ mapping (I’ll pull a canned mapping template).

I’ll sync with Kimberly before sending to Asha.

—Ben

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodeval.com>
To: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@cloudnova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodeval.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodeval.com>, CloudNova Procurement <procure@cloudnova.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: SIG prefill + evidence map for CloudNova (attached)

Hi Asha / procurement team —

Attached is the SIG Lite prefill we completed for CloudNova along with an evidence map that references the exact artifacts we can provide. Highlights: 
- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II (report dated 2026-11-15). We’ve attached the cover page and scope; full report available under NDA.
- GDPR/HIPAA: primary controls documented in the evidence map; technical controls include encryption in transit & at rest, data minimization notes, and our subprocessors list.
- Evidence we can supply immediately: encrypted KMS key policy PDF, audit log extract (redacted), screenshots of RBAC role bindings, and architecture diagram (redacted).

Please see the attachments. If procurement wants the CAIQ instead, let us know and we’ll translate the prefill to CAIQ within 48 hours.

Thanks — Ben will coordinate followups on the evidence items.

Best,
Kimberly

[Attachments: redwood_SIG_prefill_v1.xlsx (xlsx), redwood_evidence_map_20270925.pdf (pdf)]
